title: IT Systems Modernization and Reporting Improvement
raw_description: The City of Surrey is seeking a technology consulting firm to assess and improve its IT reporting capabilities across finance and operations departments. The engagement includes a current-state assessment of existing reporting tools (Excel, Access, Crystal Reports), recommendations for a modern reporting platform, limited proof-of-concept dashboard development (3–5 dashboards), and a technology roadmap. The vendor should have broad IT consulting experience, familiarity with municipal operations, and the ability to present technical findings to non-technical executives. Experience with Power BI is an asset but not a requirement.

ground_truth.rationale: Partial match — Power BI is relevant but scope is general IT consulting. Small value ($200K) and limited analytics depth make this a CONSIDER rather than strong PURSUE. Your Organization may be over-qualified.
